name: semteams-go-backend
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends jq && curl -fsSL https://taskfile.dev/install.sh | sudo sh -s -- -d -b /usr/local/bin ${TASK_VERSION}

semteams.notes: Pure backend workload. No docker socket. AllowedNetwork: restricted+none — admission rejects 'public'. Egress is NOT firewalled at the host (MVP); see .devcontainer/README.md 'Network posture' for the follow-up to add real egress controls.
